name: Madewell

prices.note: Like-for-like item: women's jeans. The page says 89 products but serves 48 tiles (same 48 with ?page=2), so the range covers 48 of 89: 44 at $148, 2 at $158, 1 at $168, 1 at $198 (Madewell x Kaihara Low-Rise Slim Jean). No struck-through or sale prices; each tile carries a promo-code line ('Up to 30% off with code REFRESH'), which is not a markdown. All listed jeans are Madewell's own label.

notes: kind=retailer: besides its own label, the 'Labels We Love' directory ('Exclusive collabs and favorite finds from around the world') lists 37 outside labels, including Birkenstock, Veja, New Balance, Teva, Onitsuka Tiger, Golde and Clem Swimwear.
Homepage title: "Women's + Men's Clothing | Jeans, Tees, Sweaters + More | Madewell".

Shipping: no order-value threshold. Free Economy/Standard shipping only for signed-in Madewell Insider members (continental US); non-members pay $5 Economy (10 business days) or $7 Standard (6 business days). So free_shipping_min_usd is left empty. Ships to 100+ countries via ESW, including Canada, the UK and Australia (International Orders page).
Returns: within 30 days of the original purchase; free US exchange label. Return fee not stated on the captured page.

Sizes: size chart page says 'Women's Plus sizes (14W–24W / 1X–3X), Petite, and Tall options across denim, tops, and dresses'; jeans guide confirms Petite (5'3" and shorter), Tall (5'9" and taller), Curvy and Plus fits; availability varies by style. Full numeric range not readable (charts are images).

Parent/HQ: the Wikipedia Madewell URL returned J.Crew Group content ('J.Crew Group, Inc., is an American multi-brand, multi-channel, specialty retailer', HQ 225 Liberty Street, New York City). hq_country US from that; founded_year left empty (the year shown, 1947, is J.Crew Group's).
